responsibility: This file implements GCC’s vtable pointer security instrumentation pass and supporting compile-time bookkeeping for virtual table verification. It builds and tracks per-class vtable map variables and class-hierarchy registration data, arranges runtime registration of valid vtable addresses, and scans GIMPLE basic blocks for virtual dispatch patterns so it can insert calls to the verification runtime before indirect virtual calls. Its responsibility is the middle-end portion of -fvtable-verify, connecting C++ class hierarchy knowledge to runtime checks that detect corrupted vtable pointers.
same_name_distinction: Contains the middle-end implementation for -fvtable-verify, including the GIMPLE pass that scans basic blocks and inserts __VLTVerifyVtablePointer calls, using the shared structures declared in vtable-verify.h.
